text:
maya: Quick sync 1: we need a crisp pattern for tokens used by internal services vs external partners. High-level: keep hot-path validation O(1) and push complexity to control-plane.

igor: Agreed. Two-token surface: user_api_key (human, role-graph-backed) and machine_cap (machine, caps list, short TTL). machine_cap should be cheap to verify in dataplane: signature + caps membership + scope match.

sandeep: For capabilities we should use route-aligned names (e.g., inference:invoke, ingest:append) and a per-route whitelist. Runtime check is a set membership test. For auditing and billing we attach a mapping_id to minted tokens that points to the projection used.

maya: Delegation: services can request a delegated single-use token when acting on behalf of a user. Control plane enforces consent and mints a 1-2 minute token with on_behalf_of claim and nonce. Runtime validates nonce via local replay cache or consults control-plane on miss.

igor: Revocation model: short TTLs by default + per-subject generation number for emergency revokes. Tokens include gen; runtime compares against cached gen. Bump gen at revoke to deny instantly. Also keep a small cap-denylist for critical capabilities.

sandeep: Partner flow: broker exchanges partner cert/JWT for proxy_token with a signed proof-of-federation (pof). Data plane validates broker signature + pof digest header; keeps hot check O(1). Broker supports multi-scope tokens but limits number of scopes.

maya: Migration: detect long-lived keys by naming heuristics and last-used patterns; surface rotation UX in console. Beta: opt-in enforcement with x-rdwd-actor header then gradual 10% canary.

igor: Security constraints: KMS-signed tokens, disallow admin:* wildcards in machine tokens except via manual approval flow recorded in audit logs. Require rotation and daily JWKS refresh.

sandeep: Telemetry & audit: log token_type, mapping_id, caps_count, validation_latency_ms, gen_mismatch_rate, mint/revoke actor. Retention: 1y for partner/admin events, 90d for internal.

maya: Action items: @igor prototype validator + local JWKS + gen cache (2w), @sandeep draft migration heuristics + console copy (1w), @maya write rollout plan + canary config (1w). auth-bot: scheduled follow-up "token-surface rollout check" 2024-05-22T10:00Z.

igor: I'll draft a short RFC with sample token shapes and validator pseudo-code. Drop edge-cases here (cross-tenant proxies, huge multi-scope syncs).

maya: Thanks everyone, will reconvene after RFC.
